units.source_text: 多日不见紫姬，她长得容貌更加美丽，举止更加端详了。

en.t: After many days without seeing Lady Murasaki, he found that she had grown even more beautiful in appearance and still more composed in manner.

units.source_text: 她担心自己今后命运，忧形于色，源氏大将看了觉得深可怜爱。

en.t: She was anxious about her future fate, and her worry showed on her face; when General Genji saw this, he felt deep pity and affection for her.

units.source_text: 他近来常常为了不应有之事而沉思梦想，

en.t: Lately he had often sunk into brooding and daydreams over something that should never have been,

units.source_text: 紫姬定然分明看出，因此她近来作诗，常用“变色”等语。

en.t: and Lady Murasaki must surely have seen it clearly, for in the poems she had composed of late she often used words such as changing color.

units.source_text: 源氏大将觉得对她不起，今日归家，对她比往日更加亲爱。

en.t: General Genji felt that he had wronged her, and when he returned home today, he treated her with even more tenderness than usual.

units.source_text: 他看看从山寺带回来的红叶，觉得比庭中的红叶颜色更浓。

en.t: Looking at the maple leaves he had brought back from the mountain temple, he felt their color was deeper than that of the leaves in the garden.

units.source_text: 想起了与藤壶皇后久不通问，毕竟不好意思，

en.t: He remembered that he had long sent no word to Empress Fujitsubo, and in the end felt uneasy about it,

units.source_text: 便无端地把山寺中带来的红叶送给她，并附一信与王命妇，

en.t: so, for no particular reason, he sent her the maple leaves he had brought from the mountain temple, and enclosed a letter to O no Myobu,

units.source_text: 信中说：“闻娘娘入宫探望太子，至深欣慰。

en.t: in which he wrote: I was deeply pleased to hear that Her Majesty entered the palace to visit the Crown Prince.

units.source_text: 我久疏问候，但两宫之事，时在念中。

en.t: I have long neglected to send my greetings, but the affairs of the two palaces are constantly in my thoughts.

units.source_text: 只因山寺礼佛诵经，原有规定日数，

en.t: It is only because the worship and sutra recitation at the mountain temple had a fixed number of days from the start,

units.source_text: 若中途退出，人将谓我不诚，因此延至今日方始返邸。

en.t: and if I had withdrawn midway, people would have called me insincere; for that reason I was delayed until today, when I finally returned to my residence.

units.source_text: 红叶一枝，色泽甚美，我一人独赏，

en.t: This single branch of maple leaves has a very beautiful color and sheen, and for me alone to admire it

units.source_text: ‘好似美锦在暗中’，甚是可惜，故特送上。

en.t: would be like fine brocade hidden in the dark, which seemed a great pity, so I have specially sent it to you.

units.source_text: 倘有机会，望呈请娘娘御览。”

en.t: If there is an opportunity, I hope you will present it for Her Majesty's viewing.
